'''H'Raak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] who disagreed with the ideas of [[A'Yark/Legends|A'Yark]]. H'Raak was killed by A'Yark and his [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] was given to her youngest son, [[A'Deen]].
